Nick Robinson

Series 1, Episode 3

The Episode

Presenter of BBC Radio 4’s Today programme and former BBC Political Editor, Nick Robinson reflects on a career spent at the heart of British politics, covering Westminster, Downing Street and some of the defining political moments of recent decades.

About Nick Robinson

Nick Robinson is a presenter of BBC Radio 4’s Today programme and a former BBC Political Editor, with a career spanning decades at the heart of British political journalism.
